variants.N0_y4_nomosaic: Y4/F5 fixed DFL=1 control with Mosaic=0
variants.N2_y4_nomosaic_support_assignment: N0 + TAL-feasible posterior support filter, top five per GT
variants.N3_y4_nomosaic_localization_distill: N0 + detached teacher DFL-distribution KL on matched positives

adaptive_zoom.source: Wang et al., Adaptive image zoom-in with bounding box transformation for UAV object detection, ISPRS JPRS 233 (2026), DOI 10.1016/j.isprsjprs.2026.01.036
adaptive_zoom.project_adaptation: training-only GT-aware crop/resize; no learned/non-uniform ZoomDet module

assignment.implementation: standard YOLO TAL candidate pool and conflict resolution followed by feasible posterior top-five support filtering

localization_distillation.source: Zheng et al., Localization Distillation for Dense Object Detection, CVPR 2022
localization_distillation.target: detached teacher DFL localization distribution on student matched positives

crosskd.source: Wang et al., CrossKD: Cross-Head Knowledge Distillation for Object Detection, CVPR 2024
crosskd.reason: would require an invasive generic head adapter; core N0-N3 remains isolated

historical_reference: Y4+Mosaic legacy results remain in results/ and are not causal baselines for N1-N3
